name: Calumet_HighTurbidity_85
description: Turbidity > 8.5 NTU at Calumet Beach with confidence > 0.85.
epl: @Name('Calumet_HighTurbidity_85') select e from Event as e where e.streamId like '%Calumet%' and e.streamId like '%Turbidity%' and e.value > 8.5 and confidence > 0.85

name: Calumet_WaterTempDrop_85
description: Water temperature < 22 °C at Calumet Beach with confidence > 0.85.
epl: @Name('Calumet_WaterTempDrop_85') select e from Event as e where e.streamId like '%Calumet%' and e.streamId like '%Water_Temperature%' and e.value < 22 and confidence > 0.85

name: Calumet_HighWave_85
description: Wave height > 0.35 m at Calumet Beach with confidence > 0.85.
epl: @Name('Calumet_HighWave_85') select e from Event as e where e.streamId like '%Calumet%' and e.streamId like '%Wave_Height%' and e.value > 0.35 and confidence > 0.85

name: Calumet_LocalAlert_85
description: High turbidity and low temperature at Calumet Beach within 20 s.
epl: @Name('Calumet_LocalAlert_85') select a as turb, b as temp from pattern [every (a=PatternRecordStream(patternName='Calumet_HighTurbidity_85') and b=PatternRecordStream(patternName='Calumet_WaterTempDrop_85')) where timer:within(20 sec)]

name: Montrose_LocalAlert_85
description: High turbidity and low temperature at Montrose Beach within 20 s.
epl: @Name('Montrose_LocalAlert_85') select a as turb, b as temp from pattern [every (a=PatternRecordStream(patternName='Montrose_HighTurbidity_85') and b=PatternRecordStream(patternName='Montrose_WaterTempDrop_85')) where timer:within(20 sec)]

name: MontroseToCalumet_AlertSpread_85
description: Montrose local alert followed by Calumet local alert within 30 s.
epl: @Name('MontroseToCalumet_AlertSpread_85') select a as north, b as south from pattern [every (a=PatternRecordStream(patternName='Montrose_LocalAlert_85') -> b=PatternRecordStream(patternName='Calumet_LocalAlert_85') where timer:within(30 sec))]

name: CalumetTo63rd_AlertSpread_85
description: Calumet local alert followed by 63rd Street local alert within 30 s.
epl: @Name('CalumetTo63rd_AlertSpread_85') select a as mid, b as south from pattern [every (a=PatternRecordStream(patternName='Calumet_LocalAlert_85') -> b=PatternRecordStream(patternName='63rd_LocalAlert_85') where timer:within(30 sec))]

name: Regional_TripleAlert_85
description: All three beaches experience local alerts within 45 s — broad-scale event.
epl: @Name('Regional_TripleAlert_85') select a as north, b as mid, c as south from pattern [every (a=PatternRecordStream(patternName='Montrose_LocalAlert_85') and b=PatternRecordStream(patternName='Calumet_LocalAlert_85') and c=PatternRecordStream(patternName='63rd_LocalAlert_85')) where timer:within(45 sec)]
